label: Organizer
description: The user's reminders and calendar. Reads and writes them without opening a window, and Titan announces them when they are due even if the Organizer is closed.

actions.name: list_reminders
actions.summary: List the user's reminders. Optionally only today's or tomorrow's.

actions.name: next_reminder
actions.summary: Say which reminder is coming up next.

actions.name: create_reminder
actions.summary: Create a reminder in the Organizer.

description.description: Text spoken or shown when it fires.

date.description: 'today', 'tomorrow' or a date like 2026-08-12. Defaults to today.

time.description: Time of day as HH:MM. Defaults to the next full hour.

which.description: The reminder's name, or its number from list_reminders.
The reminder's name, or its number from list_reminders.
